INSERT INTO attempts (id, exercise_id, transcription, recognized_text, confidence, transcription_source, status, created_at) VALUES (%(id)s::UUID, %(exercise_id)s::UUID, %(transcription)s::JSONB, %(recognized_text)s::VARCHAR, %(confidence)s, %(transcription_source)s::VARCHAR, %(status)s::VARCHAR, %(created_at)s::TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE)

SELECT attempts.id, attempts.exercise_id, attempts.transcription, attempts.recognized_text, attempts.confidence, attempts.transcription_source, attempts.confirmed_text, attempts.status, attempts.created_at 
FROM attempts JOIN exercises ON exercises.id = attempts.exercise_id 
WHERE attempts.id = %(id_1)s::UUID AND exercises.user_id = %(user_id_1)s::UUID

INSERT INTO conversations (exercise_id, data, state, pending_attempt_id, active_followup_id, updated_at) VALUES (%(exercise_id)s::UUID, %(data)s::JSONB, %(state)s::VARCHAR, %(pending_attempt_id)s::UUID, %(active_followup_id)s::UUID, %(updated_at)s::TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE) ON CONFLICT (exercise_id) DO UPDATE SET data = excluded.data, state = excluded.state, pending_attempt_id = excluded.pending_attempt_id, active_followup_id = excluded.active_followup_id, updated_at = excluded.updated_at
